title: Agonizing Blast
contents: description | Prerequisite | Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage
text | Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage rolls.
text | You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do, choose a different eligible cantrip.

title: Armor of Shadows
contents: text | You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

title: Ascendant Step
contents: text | You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.

title: Devil's Sight
contents: text | You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

title: Devouring Blade
contents: text | The Extra Attack of your Thirsting Blade invocation confers two extra attacks instead of one.

title: Eldritch Mind
contents: text | You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.

title: Eldritch Smite
contents: description | Prerequisite | Level 5+ Warlock, Pact of the Blade
text | Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, you may expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal 1d8 Force plus 1d8 per slot level.
text | If the target is Huge or smaller, it must make a Strength save or be knocked Prone.

title: Eldritch Spear
contents: description | Prerequisite | Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage
text | Choose a cantrip you know with a range of 10+ feet. Its range increases by 30 ft × your Warlock level.
text | You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time, choose a different eligible cantrip.

title: Fiendish Vigor
contents: text | You can cast False Life on yourself without using a spell slot. You gain maximum HP from the die, not a roll.

title: Repelling Blast
contents: text | Choose a Warlock cantrip that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can push it 10 feet away.
text | Repeatable: Choose a different cantrip each time.

title: Thirsting Blade
contents: text | Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade. Gain Extra Attack for your pact weapon only.
text | Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

title: Visions of Distant Realms
contents: text | You can cast Arcane Eye without expending a spell slot.

title: Whispers of the Grave
contents: text | You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

title: Witch Sight
contents: text | You gain Truesight out to 30 feet.

title: Gaze of Two Minds
contents: text | As a Bonus Action, touch a willing creature to perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn.
text | Use another Bonus Action on future turns to maintain the link, if on the same plane.
text | You gain any special senses of the creature and can cast spells from its space or yours if within 60 feet.

title: Gift of the Depths
contents: text | You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
text | You can cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without using a spell slot.

title: Gift of the Protectors
contents: text | Prerequisite: Pact of the Tome. A magical page in your Book of Shadows can hold names (up to your Charisma mod).
text | When a named creature drops to 0 HP, it instead drops to 1 HP. This benefit resets after a Long Rest.
text | As a Magic Action, you can remove a name from the page.

title: Investment of the Chain Master
contents: text | Prerequisite: Pact of the Chain. When you cast Find Familiar, it gains the following boons:
text | Speed: Choose Fly or Swim (40 ft). Attack: Can attack as Bonus Action.
text | Damage Type: Choose Necrotic or Radiant for familiar's attacks. Save DC: Uses your spell DC.
text | Resistance: Use a Reaction to give it Resistance to damage.

title: Lessons of the First Ones
contents: text | Gain one Origin Feat of your choice (see chapter 5).
text | Repeatable: Choose a different Origin feat each time you take this invocation.

title: Lifedrinker
contents: text | Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade. On hit with your pact weapon, deal extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant (your choice).
text | You may expend a Hit Die to regain 1d10 + CON HP (min 1).

title: Otherworldly Leap
contents: text | You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.
